reviews.review: Even though it's showing it's age a little, this is still a great shooter. Solid gameplay and the story is easy to understand and I'm really enjoying it even though I know next to nothing about the whole 40K universe. That being said, this game isn't worth 60 bucks. It's ten years old and it's absolutely insane that they're asking for the price of a modern day AAA release. The good thing is that you can get a key for much, much cheaper with a simple google search. All in all, solid game.

I liked the single player campaign, I played through it in like 8hrs on easy mode. I'm not much of an online shooter game player, so I skipped the multiplayer part. If you want a couple of hours of brutal violence with chainswords and big guns, go for it.

Even to someone that is not knowledgeable of Warhammer 40,000 this game should be a blast to play; the combat is challenging and addictive, the soundtrack is epic and adequate, the plot is interesting and compelling. Not much to complain about this game but the fact that it seems to end too quickly. Do yourself a favor and play it.

Fun shooter. Story is mediocre but 40k stories in videogames are never good. The warboss you fight is a great character. Love me some orc boys. Didn't bother try to play multiplayer because if it's still even supported it's probably dead. Controls aren't great but they work for a ten year-ish old game. I personally rebound the keys for my keyboard to make it easier to use. Main con why the hell was the game price brought back up to 60 USD? Probably more of Game Workshop (the company that owns the Warhammer IP) being greedy a holes. If you're interested buy it on sale. I got it for like 5 usd during a steam sale. If this for some reason never goes below 10 usd don't bother it's not worth anything more than 5 bucks
It's a good game. Fun and challenging, if you want it to be. The multiplayer is also loads of fun. For its price it's more than worth it.
